BLOCK
DROP
DG

Stack blocks with precision. Land perfect drops to keep your tower growing, earn combos, unlock themes and backgrounds, and compete on the global leaderboard.

Perfect Combos
Land perfect drops to build combos. Chain perfects together for multiplied scores and satisfying visual effects. How high can you streak?

Earn coins to unlock custom block color themes and animated backgrounds. Make your tower look exactly how you want it.

Daily Rewards
Come back every day for free coins. Build a streak for even bigger rewards. Seven days of daily bonuses to keep the coins flowing.
Legal

Privacy Policy

Effective date: March 23, 2026
Developer: Dawn Games LLC

1. Information We Collect

Block Drop DG collects minimal data to provide and improve the game experience. Game progress and scores are stored locally on your device. We use Google AdMob to display ads, which may collect device identifiers, IP address, and usage data to serve ads.

2. How We Use Information

To save your game progress locally, to display advertisements via Google AdMob, to process in-app purchases, and to maintain leaderboard functionality.

3. In-App Purchases

Block Drop DG offers optional in-app purchases (virtual coins). All transactions are processed by Apple via StoreKit. We do not store or have access to your payment information. Purchases are non-refundable. Coins are added instantly.

4. Third-Party Services

Google AdMob (advertising) — Google Privacy Policy
Apple StoreKit (in-app purchases) — Apple Privacy Policy

5. Data Storage

Game data (scores, settings, purchases) is stored locally on your device. Leaderboard scores may be stored on our servers with only a display name and score value. Uninstalling the app deletes all local data.

6. Children's Privacy

Block Drop DG does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

7. Your Choices

You can reset your game data by deleting and reinstalling the app. You can limit ad tracking in your device settings (Settings > Privacy > Tracking).

8. Contact

For questions about this privacy policy, contact: dawngames@dawngamesapp.com

Learn More

Quick Sessions

Legal

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: April 14, 2026
Developer: Dawn Games LLC

Information We Collect

Personal Information
We do NOT collect any personally identifiable information. Just Right can be played completely anonymously.

Non-Personal Information
We may collect the following non-personal information:

  • Game Statistics: High scores, coins earned, themes unlocked (stored locally on your device only)
  • Analytics Data: App usage statistics, device type, OS version (via Firebase Analytics if enabled)
  • Advertising Data: Ad interaction metrics (via AdMob)

How We Use Information

Local Storage

  • Game progress, scores, and purchases are stored locally on your device only
  • We do not transmit your game data to external servers
  • Uninstalling the app will delete all local data

Analytics (Optional)
If you opt-in to analytics:

  • We use Firebase Analytics to understand how players engage with the app
  • This helps us improve gameplay, fix bugs, and design better features
  • All data is aggregated and anonymous

Advertising

  • We use Google AdMob to display ads
  • AdMob may collect device identifiers and usage data to serve personalized ads
  • You can opt out of personalized ads in your device settings (iOS: Settings → Privacy → Advertising)

Third-Party Services

We use the following third-party services:

Google AdMob

  • Purpose: Display advertisements
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Data Collected: Device ID, ad interaction metrics

Firebase Analytics (Optional)

  • Purpose: App usage analytics
  • Privacy Policy: https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy
  • Data Collected: Device type, OS version, session duration, crash reports

Apple App Store / Google Play Store

  • In-App Purchases: Handled by Apple/Google's payment systems
  • Privacy Policies:
    • • Apple: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/
    • • Google: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Children's Privacy

Just Right does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. The app is suitable for all ages and does not require account creation or personal data entry.

Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Delete Data: Uninstall the app to remove all local data
  • Opt Out of Ads: Use device settings to limit ad tracking
  • Opt Out of Analytics: Disable analytics in the app's Settings menu

Data Security

  • All game data is stored locally on your device
  • We do not operate servers that store user information
  • Third-party services (AdMob, Firebase) use industry-standard security practices

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted within the app and on our website.

Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:

Dawn Games
Email: dawngames@dawngamesapp.com
Website: https://dawngamesapp.com

By using Just Right, you agree to this Privacy Policy.

Beamer Connect  •  In Development

The easiest, safest BMW companion app.

Plain-English diagnostics. One-tap maintenance resets. ECU coding with automatic safety backups. Live vehicle data on your phone.

Built for BMW owners who want confidence without a scan tool.

Follow the build → Join the Discord →
In development · iOS 16+ · iPhone only
Features Preview

Everything a scan tool does. Nothing you have to decode.

Four core tools, designed to be understood at a glance and safe to use on your own car.

Diagnose

Read the codes, in plain English

Pull fault codes and see them translated into plain language — what's wrong, what it affects, and what to check next. No cross-referencing a forum thread.

Maintenance

Track and reset in one tap

Keep an eye on service items — oil, brakes, filters, and more — and reset them the moment the work is done. No dealer visit to clear the reminder.

Coding

Customize with a safety net

Enable the features you want with guided coding. Every write is preceded by an automatic backup, so you can always roll back to how the car left the factory.

Live Data

Real numbers, in real time

Watch RPM, speed, coolant temp, throttle, boost, and battery voltage live as you drive — the vitals that tell you how the car is really doing.

Before You Start

What you'll need

Beamer Connect is still in development. Here's what it's being built to run on.

  • StatusIn development — early access is coming. Follow the build to know when it's ready.
  • DeviceiPhone running iOS 16 or later. iPhone-only at launch.
  • AdapterA WiFi OBD adapter (MHD or ELM327-compatible) plugged into your car's OBD-II port.
  • VehicleBMW. Feature and coding support varies by model and year.

the-watch.body:
This record exists so that every resident of the island understands the truth of our shared history — not the rumors spread by agitators, but the facts. Read it carefully. Share it with your family. Those who understand the past do not repeat its mistakes.

The Island Before

Before The Watch, the island called itself free. In practice, it was fragile.

Power failed in the outer towns for days at a time. The docks were run by men who answered to no one. Crime in the city went unrecorded because there was no one to record it. The island's so-called government held elections, made promises, and let the roads crumble between them.

The people were not safe. They were simply unwatched. There is a difference, and they learned it too late.

Our Arrival

We came at the island's own invitation.

The government, unable to secure its most sensitive facility, contracted our organization to provide what it could not provide itself: order. We brought equipment. We brought wages. We brought the first reliable power the outer sectors had seen in a generation.

We asked for cooperation. The island gave it gladly. This is a matter of record, whatever you may now hear whispered.

The Transition

It is said by some that The Watch "seized" the island. This is false.

The previous government was offered every opportunity to govern responsibly. It declined. When it became clear that its leaders cared more for their offices than for the people they had abandoned, those leaders stepped aside. Some left the island. Others chose not to be found. We do not pursue cowards.

In their absence, someone had to keep the lights on. Someone had to keep the food moving and the docks running and the children safe in their beds. We did not ask for that responsibility. We accepted it.

They were not safe. They were simply unwatched.

The New Order

What the disloyal call "restriction," the wise call "structure."

Checkpoints exist so that no stranger moves through your neighborhood unseen. Curfews exist so that the night belongs to the law-abiding, not the lawless. Cameras exist not to watch you — the honest citizen has nothing to fear from being seen — but to watch over you.

We hear the complaints. We weigh them against the silence of every family that now sleeps soundly. The arithmetic is not difficult.

On the Subject of the Missing

You will hear it said that people "disappear."

People relocate. People are reassigned. People who break faith with the island are removed from the company of those who keep it. This is not cruelty. It is hygiene.

A body removes what threatens it. So does a healthy society. To call this injustice is to call the immune system a murderer.

NOTICE TO ALL CITIZENS: Report relocations, absences, and unregistered persons to your Sector Warden within 24 hours. Failure to report is itself a reportable offense. A safe island is a watched island.

On the Resistance

There are those who hide in the forests and call themselves "The Dawn."

We will be plain: they are not freedom fighters. They are the residue of the old disorder — the smugglers, the malcontents, the ones who profited when no one was watching and now resent being watched. They romanticize a past that nearly killed this island. They offer you chaos and call it hope.

When you see their marks painted over our notices, do not be afraid. Be grateful. It means there is still something here worth defacing — something we built, that they could only ruin.

Report them. Not for our sake. For your neighbors'.

The Future

The island is safe now. It is fed, lit, and ordered. Children grow up never having known the fear their parents knew.

This is the gift The Watch gave the island. We ask only one thing in return, and we ask it of every citizen, every day: Obey. They Watch. And we always will.

Sanctioned Slogans

Obey. They Watch.
Order Through Unity.
Compliance Is Protection.
Loyalty Is Freedom.
One Island. One Future.
A Safe Island Is A Watched Island.
The Watch Never Sleeps.
Security. Order. Prosperity.
Obey. They Watch.

the-dawn.body:
If you're holding this, someone trusted you. That's not nothing anymore. Read it once, learn it, then move it along or burn it. They search for paper now.

What it was like before

You probably remember. If you're young, ask someone who does.

The docks ran loud every morning. The mill never stopped. Kids walked to school without papers. The power went out sometimes and we complained about it like it was the worst thing in the world. We didn't know. God, we didn't know how good the worst thing in the world used to be.

It wasn't perfect. It was ours. Nobody asked your name at a checkpoint to let you walk to your own mother's house.

How they took it

Slow. That's the part nobody believes until they've lived it. Nobody kicked the door in on day one.

First it was jobs. Then it was cameras, "for our safety." Then a curfew, "just for a while." Each thing alone, you could live with. That was the trick. By the time it was bad enough to fight, fighting was already treason.

They never conquered us. We agreed to it, one reasonable little step at a time, until there was nothing left to agree to.

Where we came from

We weren't soldiers. Most of us still aren't.

It started small. A fisherman who hid fuel from a patrol. A mechanic who kept fixing trucks for families who weren't allowed to travel. A teacher who buried the real books in her yard so the kids would know what was taken. An old soldier who showed scared people how to not be scared.

Nobody founded us. There's no headquarters. There's no general. That's our strength and they can't understand it — you can't behead a thing that has no head. Burn one camp and another lights its fire that night.

The name

Somebody said it around a fire, back in the bad winter. Morning always comes.

We don't know who. Doesn't matter. It went mouth to mouth through the forests until it stopped being a sentence and started being a name.

We didn't pick it because we think we'll win. We picked it because the night doesn't get a vote on whether the sun comes up.

The night doesn't get a vote on whether the sun comes up.

What we believe

They want you obedient. We want you free — and free is harder, because free means you have to choose, and choosing is frightening when they've made fear the only currency left.

They built walls and called it safety. We keep fires and call it home.

They watch. Fine. Let them. A camera can see a man walk into the woods. It can't see what he decides while he's in there.

What you can do

You don't have to carry a rifle. Most of us don't, most days.

Hide a neighbor. Move a message. Feed someone who's hungrier than you. Remember a name they wanted forgotten. Teach a kid the real history. Paint over one of their posters and let them spend the morning scrubbing it.

Every small thing is a brick. We are building something they can't see yet.

What to do when it's hard

It will be. Camps fall. People you love will be taken, and some won't come back, and there will be nights the whole thing feels like a story we tell ourselves to keep from freezing.

Keep going anyway. Not because we're sure. Because surrender is the only guaranteed way to lose.

Found painted over their banners, three sectors this month alone:
"THEY TOOK OUR HOME. WE'LL TAKE IT BACK."  —  "WE REMEMBER."  —  "GOOD. LET THEM WATCH."

For a lot of us, that's what The Dawn really is. Not revenge. Not war. Not politics. Just the belief that one day, when the fighting is over, the island belongs to its people again. And when that day comes — the Dawn will finally arrive.

What we say to each other

The Dawn Is Coming.
Morning Always Comes.
Rise. Resist. Reclaim.
We Remember.
Build. Defend. Survive.
We Fight For Each Other.
Hope Lives Here.
The Island Belongs To Us.
They will never own the sunrise.

privacy.body:
Last updated: April 7, 2026 · Dawn Games LLC

Overview

Dawn Games develops free-to-play mobile games (including Block Drop DG). This policy covers all games published by Dawn Games and explains what data is collected and how it's used.

Advertising

Our games use Google AdMob to display ads. AdMob may collect device advertising ID (GAID on Android, IDFA on iOS), IP address (anonymized), general location (country/region level), and app usage data for ad personalization.

iOS Users — App Tracking Transparency (ATT): On iOS, we will ask for your permission before tracking your activity across other companies' apps and websites for advertising purposes. You can change this at any time in your device settings under Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking. If you decline tracking, you will still see ads, but they will be less personalized.

Android Users: You can opt out of personalized ads in your device settings under Google → Ads → Opt out of Ads Personalization.

Game Data

Game progress is stored locally on your device only. We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal information. No account creation or login required. No names, emails, or phone numbers collected.

Tournament Leaderboards

Some games (like Block Drop DG) feature weekly tournament leaderboards. If you participate, the following data is collected and stored on Google Firebase servers:

  • Display name (chosen by you in-game)
  • Score (game performance data)
  • Device identifier (to track unique players)
  • Timestamp (when score was submitted)

What is NOT collected: No email addresses, phone numbers, real names, location data, or any personally identifiable information.

Tournament scores are publicly visible on the leaderboard. You can opt out by not participating in tournaments.

In-App Purchases

Some of our games offer optional in-app purchases (e.g. virtual coins). All transactions are processed by Apple via StoreKit. We do not store or have access to your payment information. Purchases are non-refundable.

Analytics

We do not use any analytics or tracking SDKs beyond what is included in AdMob.

Children's Privacy

Our games are not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

Third-Party Services

  • • Google AdMob — Privacy Policy
  • • Google Firebase/Firestore — Privacy Policy
  • • Google User Messaging Platform (UMP) — Used to manage consent for ads and tracking.
  • • SKAdNetwork (iOS) — Apple's privacy-preserving ad attribution framework. No personal data is shared.

Data Retention

Local game data: Stored on your device only. Uninstalling deletes all local data.

Tournament data: Stored on Firebase servers for the duration of active tournaments (typically 7 days). Old tournament data is automatically deleted when new tournaments begin.

Contact

Questions? Contact us at: dawngames@dawngamesapp.com
